result.summary: Found 1 layout issue where a restaurant title in the 'Popular right now' section is prematurely clipped mid-character despite ample available space.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' under 'Popular right now' is abruptly cut off mid-character ('Tokumaru Rameı') without an ellipsis, even though there is plenty of unused horizontal space before the rating badge on the right.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title container to flex and use available space up to the rating element (e.g., flex: 1 with an appropriate gap), and apply text-overflow: ellipsis for genuinely long names.
